title: askellia sogdiana
intro: Askellia sogdiana, commonly known as Sogdian alpine, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. Its therapeutic actions include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Askellia sogdiana include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
